title: SUSTUM source-backed real-world detection pilot
methodology: Small source-backed pilot corpus. Excerpts are pinned to upstream commits and manually reviewed for their expected crypto or non-crypto context. These labels have not yet received independent external reviewer sign-off. Positive cases include expected callsite line and purpose so algorithm-only matches do not hide weak contextual detection.
